description: Net-worth headline card for the Accounts screen. The single floating card (glassFloating). Shows net worth, a 30-day sparkline + delta chip, and an Assets vs Debts split summary.

history.description: Time-ordered net-worth snapshots for the Sparkline; <2 points renders the Sparkline placeholder

deltaPercent.description: First-vs-last percent change over the window; null hides the delta chip

deltaDays.description: Window length label for the delta chip

balanceVisible.description: When false, currency values render as bullets and delta % masks

accessibility.label: Net worth {netWorth}, {up|down} {deltaPercent} percent over {deltaDays} days. Assets {totalAssets}, debts {totalDebts}.
accessibility.note: Delta encoded by arrow (up/down) + word + percent, not color alone.
